final_answer:
Alphabet and Meta both report on a comparable basis (consolidated revenues, fiscal years ended December 31, 2022 and 2024), so the growth rates are directly comparable.

From the filings:
- Alphabet revenue: $282,836M in 2022 and $350,018M in 2024. [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]  
- Meta revenue: $116,609M in 2022 and $164,501M in 2024. [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]

Cumulative revenue growth 2022→2024 (using (2024/2022 − 1)):
- Alphabet: ≈ 23.8% growth. [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]  
- Meta: ≈ 41.1% growth. [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]

Difference:
- Meta’s cumulative revenue growth exceeded Alphabet’s by about 17 percentage points (≈41.1% − 23.8% ≈ 17.3%). [DOC: alpha_meta_cumulative.txt]

ANSWER: Meta, by roughly 17 percentage points.
